rubrics.justification: Generally captures a poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerative ICM and poor TE, but introduces uncertainty and some potentially unsupported details (e.g., zona thinning, fragmentation/collapse artifacts, alternate CE label) and notes a discrepancy with the provided grade.

Integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior live birth, prior failed cycle, endometrial thickness, partner age, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis; only minor omissions such as limited discussion of diagnosis/protocol specifics.

Reasoning is mostly logical and structured, linking poor morphology and age-related aneuploidy risk to low implantation odds. Minor inconsistency appears in discussing grading ambiguity and multiple probability phrasings, but overall conclusions are supported.

Largely consistent with Gardner-based morphology interpretation and evidence-based IVF counseling, including cautious discussion of PGT-A and avoiding unsupported add-ons. Small deviations include speculative freeze-all/progesterone comments not grounded in the provided case.

Provides practical counseling for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, review of embryology outcomes, consideration of PGT-A in future cycles, stimulation review, and sperm DNA fragmentation testing. Useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain somewhat general.
